no_rule_decisions.reason: BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS loop and EVALUATE WS-IDX only place option text on screen lines OPTN001O-OPTN010O (presentation).

observations.text: COADM01C never checks CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN; the admin role is enforced only by COSGN00C routing. Any program/transaction passing a commarea (or starting CA00 with one) reaches the admin functions.
After an invalid option the message branch is skipped by IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON, but WS-OPTION may be 0 or > table size; no subscript is used in that case (unlike COMEN01C), so no out-of-range access.
The option name is commented out of the 'not installed' message, so the message never names the option.
PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA ends with END-EXEC. followed by a stray period line; and the PGMIDERR handler remains active for the whole task including the RETURN-TO-SIGNON XCTL.
RECEIVE MAP RESP/RESP2 captured but never tested.
WS-USRSEC-FILE and copybook CSUSR01Y are declared but not used.

paragraphs.logic: Registers HANDLE CONDITION PGMIDERR(PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA), clears the error flag and message. If EIBCALEN = 0 it sets CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM='COSGN00C' and returns to sign-on; otherwise it copies DFHCOMMAREA into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, and on first entry (not CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) sets the re-enter flag and sends the menu. On re-entry it receives the map: ENTER performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, PF3 sets CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM='COSGN00C' and returns to sign-on, other keys redisplay with CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY. Ends with CICS RETURN TRANSID('CA00').
paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA

paragraphs.logic: Trims trailing blanks from OPTIONI, right-justifies it into WS-OPTION-X, replaces blanks by '0' and moves it to WS-OPTION. Non-numeric, zero or > CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT options redisplay the menu with 'Please enter a valid option number...'. Otherwise, if CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION) does not start with 'DUMMY', it sets CDEMO-FROM-TRANID/PROGRAM and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT=0 and XCTLs to that program; if no transfer occurred it shows green 'This option is not installed ...' and redisplays the menu.
paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY

paragraphs.logic: Defaults CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM to 'COSGN00C' when low-values or spaces, then XCTLs to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM without a commarea.
paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Performs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO and BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS, moves WS-MESSAGE to ERRMSGO and sends map COADM1A (mapset COADM01) with ERASE.
paragraphs.name: SEND-MENU-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Receives map COADM1A into COADM1AI capturing RESP/RESP2, which are not tested afterwards.
paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Moves FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE to WS-CURDATE-DATA, CCDA-TITLE01/CCDA-TITLE02 to TITLE01O/TITLE02O, WS-TRANID to TRNNAMEO and WS-PGMNAME to PGMNAMEO of COADM1AO; rebuilds the date as WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY (MM/DD/YY from WS-CURDATE-MONTH, WS-CURDATE-DAY, WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2)) into CURDATEO and the time as WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS into CURTIMEO.
paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO

paragraphs.logic: Loops WS-IDX from 1 to CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT building 'nn. option name' and moving it to OPTN001O..OPTN010O according to WS-IDX; higher indexes are ignored.
paragraphs.name: BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS

paragraphs.logic: Entered by the PGMIDERR handler when an XCTL target is not defined: shows green 'This option is not installed ...', redisplays the menu and issues CICS RETURN TRANSID(CA00) with the commarea.
paragraphs.name: PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA

rules.conditions: WS-OPTION NOT NUMERIC or > CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT or = 0
messages: Please enter a valid option number...
rules.outcome: Error flag set, menu redisplayed with message
rules.statement: The admin menu option must be numeric, non-zero and not greater than CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT (6 in COADM02Y); otherwise the menu is redisplayed with 'Please enter a valid option number...'. Trailing blanks are trimmed and remaining blanks replaced by zeros before the check.

When the program of a selected admin option is not defined to CICS (PGMIDERR on XCTL), the admin menu does not abend: it shows 'This option is not installed ...' in green, redisplays the menu and continues the conversation with transaction CA00.

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: Sign-on transfer, menu display, option processing or invalid-key message
rules.statement: The admin menu distinguishes first entry from re-entry with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT: entered from another program it sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and only displays the menu; input is processed only on re-entry. A start without commarea is sent to sign-on COSGN00C. Any key other than ENTER or PF3 redisplays the menu with 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.

sme_questions.question: Should the admin menu itself verify CDEMO-USER-TYPE = 'A' (defence in depth), or is sign-on routing considered sufficient?

summary.text: COADM01C is the CICS pseudo-conversational administrator menu of CardDemo, transaction CA00, map COADM1A of mapset COADM01. It establishes a HANDLE CONDITION PGMIDERR so that a missing option program produces an 'is not installed' message. Without a commarea it transfers to COSGN00C; on first entry it sets the re-enter flag and displays the option list from COADM02Y (6 options: user list/add/update/delete and the two Db2 transaction-type programs). On ENTER it normalises and validates the option number against CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT and XCTLs to the option's program with the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA unless the program name starts with DUMMY. PF3 returns to COSGN00C; other keys redisplay the menu with an invalid-key message. Each turn ends with CICS RETURN TRANSID(CA00) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).
